title: Contact Lens Order Boxes Ordered Leaderboard
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=contacts:order boxes_ordered=*
| stats sum(boxes_ordered) as total_value, avg(boxes_ordered) as avg_value by lens_brand
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks lens brand values by total and average boxes ordered across contact lens order events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `boxes_ordered` values for each contact lens order event and review total and average boxes ordered by lens brand.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total boxes ordered.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which lens brand shows the biggest boxes ordered numbers in your contact lens order data.
